q: Chianti Classico's top tier since 2014 is:
exp: Above Riserva (24) and annata (12); 2023 added 11 UGA village mentions for it.

q: Name three of Chianti Classico's UGA (Unità Geografiche Aggiuntive) villages.
exp: The village names may appear on Gran Selezione labels from 2023.

q: Which 'Super Tuscan' from Tenuta San Guido holds its own DOC, created 2013?
Vino Nobile di Montepulciano's Sangiovese goes locally by:
exp: Tuscan town, Sangiovese wine — never the Abruzzo grape.

q: Vernaccia di San Gimignano was Italy's first DOC in which year?
exp: 1966; the tower town's white, praised by Dante's Purgatorio.

q: Sagrantino di Montefalco's claim to fame among red grapes is:
ans: The highest polyphenol/tannin levels of any major variety
exp: Caprai led the modern revival; passito was the tradition.

q: Torgiano Rosso Riserva DOCG is effectively the monopole achievement of which family?
exp: Umbria's quiet first DOCG alongside Montefalco.

q: Verdicchio's other DOCG riserva zone, beside Castelli di Jesi, is:
exp: Italy's most age-worthy 'humble' white; Bucci the classicist.

q: Montepulciano d'Abruzzo's rosato tradition is named:
exp: Cherry-red rosato; Valentini and Emidio Pepe make the region's icons.

q: Taurasi DOCG requires which grape at ≥85% and what aging?
accept: aglianico three years one in wood
exp: Mastroberardino kept it alive through the 20th century.

q: Campania's two white DOCGs of Avellino are Fiano di Avellino and:
exp: Fiano: hazelnut-honey wax; Greco: stony, saline, volcanic.

q: Which Basilicata DOCG grows Aglianico on the slopes of an extinct volcano?
exp: Monte Vulture's black soils; harvest into November.

q: Primitivo di Manduria is genetically the same variety as Zinfandel and which Croatian original?
ans: Crljenak Kaštelanski / Tribidrag — the same variety, not a parent
exp: Carole Meredith's DNA work closed the case in 2001. Tribidrag IS a parent of Plavac Mali, with Dobricic — don't confuse the two relationships.

q: Etna Rosso must be built on which grape, and what are its named crus called?
ans: Nerello Mascalese (≥80%); the contrade (~133 lava-flow parcels)
exp: Benanti, Graci, Passopisciaro bottle by contrada; pre-phylloxera vines survive in the sands.

q: Cerasuolo di Vittoria, Sicily's only DOCG, blends Nero d'Avola with:
exp: COS and Occhipinti carry its natural-wine fame, often in amphora.

q: Match the volcanic wine to its home.
ans: Carricante–Etna Bianco · Falanghina–Campi Flegrei · Lacryma Christi–Vesuvio · N. Cappuccio–Etna
exp: Carricante's Etna Bianco Superiore is Milo's alone.
